annotations.annotation_text: Page 320 opens Book 2, Chapter 3 ("The Tavern") during the Age of Heroes phase. This passage continues HCE behind the bar at his Chapelizod pub, the Norwegian Captain tale, the television broadcast, the twelve customers drinking and judging, featuring HCE, the Twelve Customers, Butt and Taff.
